text:
elaine: Noticed a gap between SCIM state and our RBAC audit CSVs for ~20 users after yesterday's role rename.
sam: saw some provisioning failures around 07:50-08:00 UTC; logs show a handful of 403s from the provisioner.
matt: can you dump the lines? i'll grep the audit pipeline for inconsistencies.
elaine: paste (sanitized):
```
2024-11-06T07:51:12Z scim-provisioner request_id=req-7a response=403 error="kms:AccessDenied"
2024-11-06T07:51:12Z scim id=U-111 action=delete status=retry
```
irene: kms:AccessDenied usually maps to either key policy or IAM change. did we rotate the KMS key or modify service role policies in the role rename?
deploy-bot: deploy 2024.11.06.07:45 role-rename started by @sam
deploy-bot: deploy 2024.11.06.07:48 succeeded
sam: ops ran a role rename script at 07:48 that updated a handful of service roles. checking if it overwrote inline policies.
matt: quick checklist: 1) verify KMS key state (Enabled + correct alias) 2) verify provisioner role has kms:Decrypt 3) re-run a single SCIM delete with debug headers
elaine: retried remove for U-111, still 403. debug: `Response: 403 {\"error\":\"kms:AccessDenied\"}`
irene: SIEM shows PutRolePolicy event at 07:49 from ops-bot that removed an inline statement referencing kms:Decrypt. that would do it.
sam: re-applied kms:Decrypt on the provisioner role; running a reconciliation job now.
security-bot: Recon job queued: scim-reconcile-2024-11-06-08:10 (id rcon-9123)
matt: note: our RBAC export process writes the CSV before final SCIM confirmations; if SCIM hits a transient error the CSV can keep the user active until reconciliation completes.
elaine: reconciliation run picked up changes and removed 18 users that were stuck. patching rotation playbook to validate service role policies before replacing them.
sam: opened INFRA-2379: "rotation-playbook: verify dependent IAM policies for SCIM clients" with proposed pre-rotation checks and smoke test commands.
irene: also adding an alert: provisioner emitting >3 kms:AccessDenied in 5m -> page oncall.
matt: validation: re-run test delete succeeded after policy fix; audit CSV ingestion updated at 08:12 UTC.
elaine: retrospective note: role rename utility should never replace inline policies for service accounts. switch to templated attachments + smoke tests.
elaine: will monitor for 30m then close if no regressions :thumbsup:
